errors.text_span: According to the top legend, the three bars within each group correspond sequentially from left to right to the methods "Standard," "CInGS (w/)", and "CInGS."
errors.evidence: The legend shows three identical gray color swatches next to the method names; it does not provide any information to map the methods to the bars in the chart. The description incorrectly presents an inference (that the bars are ordered sequentially according to the legend) as a fact explicitly stated by the legend.

The description states that the visually emphasized bar has a 'solid black outline' as part of its emphasis. However, all bars in the chart have a similar thin black outline; it is not a feature unique to the emphasized bar.
